data.name: Azka
data.gender_notes: Azka is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Azka is derived from the Arabic root 'Z-K-Y' meaning purity and cleanliness. It signifies a person who is pure and virtuous. The name Azka carries the meaning “Pure and Clean” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azka usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Azka is related to the Quranic concept of 'Tazkiyah' or purification of the soul, emphasizing the importance of spiritual cleanliness.
data.etymology: Azka belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Clean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azka total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عزكا
in_arabic.meaning: عزكا تعني النقاء و العفاف و الرفعة في الأخلاق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزكا مشتق من العزّة و الكرامة، و يعني النقاء و العفاف و الرفعة في الأخلاق. و هو اسم يدل على علو الشأن و المكانة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و رفيعة في الثقافة الإسلامية و اللغة العربية.

in_urdu.name: عزکا
in_urdu.meaning: عزکا مطلب ہے پاکیزگی، عفت اور اخلاق میں بلندی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزکا نام عزت اور کرامت سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پاکیزگی، عفت اور اخلاق میں بلندی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید اور جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی ثقافت میں اعلیٰ مقام اور شان کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़का
in_hindi.meaning: अज़का का अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता और चरित्र में उत्कृष्टता
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़का नाम सम्मान और गरिमा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता और चरित्र में उत्कृष्टता। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उच्च दर्जा और प्रतिष्ठा का प्रतीक है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका विशेष महत्व है।

in_pashto.name: عزکا
in_pashto.meaning: عزکا د پاکۍ، عفت او د اخلاقو د لوړتوب معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزکا نوم د عزت او کرامت څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د پاکۍ، عفت او د اخلاقو د لوړتوب معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو او اسلامي ميراث په منځ کې د لوړ شان او درناوي نښه ده.

in_english.name: Azka
in_english.meaning: Azka means purity, chastity, and excellence in character
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azka is derived from the Arabic roots 'Izz and Kafa, which convey meanings of honor, dignity, and loftiness. In Islamic tradition, Azka signifies purity, chastity, and excellence in character. It is a name that reflects high moral values and is associated with nobility and distinction. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual and ethical excellence.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عزکا

data.cultural_impact: The name Azka has strong cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is associated with a fundamental tenet of Islamic faith and practice - maintaining cleanliness and purity. Islam emphasizes the importance of physical cleanliness as a means to attain spiritual purity. The concept of cleanliness is deeply intertwined with the Islamic values of hygiene, health, and morality.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Azka holds great spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes a person who strives to maintain both outer and inner purity. The Islamic principle of "Taharah" (purification) is essential for performing sacred rituals and for maintaining a close connection with Allah (God). Azka is a name that evokes a sense of purity, virtue, and holiness, reflecting the spiritual aspirations of the person who bears this name. It serves as a constant reminder of the believer's commitment to leading a life that is pleasing to Allah and upholding the highest Islamic values.
